description: This file defines the TaxItem class, which extends OrderTotalItem and includes properties for label and associated TaxRate, representing a tax-related item in the sales management system.

classes.name: TaxItem
classes.description: A class that extends OrderTotalItem, representing a tax-related item with label and tax rate information.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label for the tax item.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the tax item.

methods.name: setTaxRate
methods.description: Sets the TaxRate associated with this tax item.

methods.name: getTaxRate
methods.description: Returns the TaxRate associated with this tax item.
